query: with c as (select x->>'essay_question_id' as question_id, x->>'leaf_id' as leaf_id, x->>'essay_exam_id' as exam_id from jsonb_array_elements(math_private.release_catalog(null)) x) select u.slug,count(distinct e.id) as exams,count(*) as math_catalog_questions from c join public.essay_exams e on e.id::text=c.exam_id join public.universities u on u.id=e.university_id where coalesce(e.field_or_division,'') ~ '자연|수리|이학|공학|의예|약학|수학|물리|화학|생명과학|지구과학' group by u.slug order by u.slug
scope: Read-only current Math backend release catalog; not current WEB deployment or real-user E2E
